samples.notes: All 4 embeddings are placed on the slide part (SlidePart), not PresentationPart: the OpenXml SDK rejects EmbeddedObjectPart/EmbeddedPackagePart/ImagePart as direct children of PresentationPart (confirmed at runtime against DocumentFormat.OpenXml 3.5.1), contradicting this generator's original doc comment. Fixed in this task: PptxSampleGenerator now targets SlidePart for both embedding kinds, and ExtractionHelper.ExtractFirstLayerEmbedded's per-slide scan was extended to also recognize EmbeddedObjectPart/EmbeddedPackagePart (previously ImagePart only), so first-layer object embeddings on a slide are now detected too.

samples.notes: All 4 embeddings are correctly placed on the WorksheetPart (WorkbookPart cannot hold ImagePart/EmbeddedObjectPart directly). NOT yet detected end-to-end: the production path wired into MainExtractor for xlsx is ExtractorOLE.Helpers.FileTypeStrategy.ExcelOpenStrategy, which calls the shared ExtractionHelper.ExtractFirstLayerEmbedded -- that method only scans WorkbookPart.Parts, not WorksheetPart.Parts, so it currently finds 0 embeddings here. A different, currently-unused code path (ExtractorOLE.Old.Excel.ExcelExtractor) was fixed for this exact gap on the not-yet-merged branch for task T-02637847, but that class is not referenced by ServiceRegistration/MainExtractor, so its fix does not (by itself) make this sample detectable through the real extraction pipeline. expectedSubfiles above use ExtractionHelper's embedded_object_N naming/index scheme (the path that actually needs the WorksheetPart scan added) so this entry is ready to flip to detectable:true once that scan is added there, mirroring the fix already applied to the pptx slide scan in this same task.
